headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow 3-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, led by Hao-Yu Lee's strong performance. The Washington Nationals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-3 behind CJ Abrams' 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Robbie Ray earned the win for the San Francisco Giants in their 9-2 rout of the Los Angeles Angels. The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox 6-0 behind Dylan Cease's 9.0 innings pitched and 12 strikeouts.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Athletics catcher Shea Langeliers has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a torn meniscus in his right knee. The Minnesota Twins, Texas Rangers, Houston Astros, New York Mets, Cleveland Guardians, and Philadelphia Phillies have also suffered injuries to Mike Paredes, Josh Jung, Spencer Arrighetti, Juan Soto, Shawn Armstrong, and Tanner Banks, respectively.

The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead. The Philadelphia Phillies acquired CF Kameron Misner from the Kansas City Royals for cash, while the Pittsburgh Pirates traded for RHP Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres. The Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win, while Clayton Beeter earned the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Angels 9-2**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels, winning 9-2 behind a strong performance from Robbie Ray, who earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Shea Langeliers on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics catcher Shea Langeliers has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a torn meniscus in his right knee. The injury is retroactive to July 25, 2026.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Acquire Curtis Mead in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, trading LHP Connelly Early to the Washington Nationals in exchange for 3B Curtis Mead.
